path_normalization.note: Both spellings of each aliasable bin/sbin path are materialized as real keys; /usr/local/bin, /opt, /usr/lib*, /usr/libexec, /usr/share and /var are never aliased. alias_of maps each derived (materialized) spelling to the canonical spelling the distro metadata actually recorded, so a UI can collapse the pair while an exact lookup on either key still resolves.

coverage_note: This map indexes only executable paths (those whose path contains '/bin/' or '/sbin/'). A path not found here is NOT evidence that the node is unaffected: the path may be outside the indexed prefixes (e.g. a library under /usr/lib or a file under /opt not listed here), or owned by a package the distro advisory feed does not track. See 'owner_scope' for whether owners were filtered to packages actually installed on the node. Treat a miss as 'unknown / out of scope', never as 'clean'.
